title: payment-service high error rate — 503s spiking to 45%
description: Upstream database connection pool exhausted due to slow query in deploy v2.4.1.
ground_truth_root_cause: database connection pool exhausted

title: payment-service memory leak causing OOM restarts
description: OOM kills caused by listener leak in billing middleware introduced in v2.3.0.
ground_truth_root_cause: listener leak / memory leak in billing middleware

title: auth-service JWT validation latency spike
description: Thundering herd issue due to concurrent expiration of Redis JWKS cache.
ground_truth_root_cause: JWKS cache expiration thundering herd

title: auth-service complete outage — misconfigured TLS cert
description: Cert rotation missing SAN for internal cluster DNS name, causing connection errors.
ground_truth_root_cause: missing SAN in rotated TLS certificate

title: notification-service queue backlog — emails delayed 2h
description: Worker count accidentally reduced from 8 to 1 during Helm chart upgrade.
ground_truth_root_cause: notification worker count misconfiguration

title: notification-service Slack webhook rate limit exceeded
description: Slack webhook rate limit hit under heavy alert storm. Needs backoff and queueing.
ground_truth_root_cause: Slack API rate limiting under alert storm

title: api-gateway 502 cascade — upstream connection refused
description: Readiness probe path mismatch in payment-service rollout left zero active pods.
ground_truth_root_cause: readiness probe configuration mismatch

title: api-gateway TLS 1.0 deprecation breaking legacy clients
description: Enforcing TLS 1.2+ broke legacy B2B clients using Java 7 or .NET 4.5.
ground_truth_root_cause: TLS 1.0 deprecation breaking legacy clients

title: payment-service duplicate charge bug after retry storm
description: Network timeout retries duplicated charges because Redis idempotency key TTL was too short (60s).
ground_truth_root_cause: idempotency key expiry too short

title: auth-service token refresh race condition causing logout loops
description: Mobile client concurrent refresh requests raced, leading to invalid refresh tokens.
ground_truth_root_cause: token refresh race condition causing invalidation

title: search-service CPU spike — regex denial of service
description: Catastrophic backtracking in search query regex parser causing CPU throttling.
ground_truth_root_cause: regex denial of service in query parser

title: inventory-service database deadlock during flash sale
description: Un-ordered row locking in inventory update transaction causing Postgres deadlocks.
ground_truth_root_cause: un-ordered row locking in inventory transaction

title: billing-service third-party gateway timeout surge
description: Stripe API HTTP connection timeout without fallback circuit breaker.
ground_truth_root_cause: Stripe API connection timeout without fallback

title: order-service Kafka consumer lag growing exponentially
description: Poison pill message format in order-events topic causing consumer infinite retry loop.
ground_truth_root_cause: poison pill message causing consumer retry loop

title: recommendation-service Redis memory fragmentation alert
description: Eviction policy set to noeviction under peak cache load causing OOM errors.
ground_truth_root_cause: Redis eviction policy set to noeviction

title: user-service DNS resolution failure in K8s
description: CoreDNS pod eviction causing intermittent DNS lookup timeouts across cluster.
ground_truth_root_cause: CoreDNS pod eviction causing DNS lookup timeouts

title: metrics-service disk full alert — Prometheus WAL
description: Prometheus WAL directory disk usage reached 98% due to un-truncated metrics retention.
ground_truth_root_cause: Prometheus WAL disk retention capacity exceeded

title: content-service CDN cache invalidation failure
description: Stale S3 bucket policy blocking CloudFront edge cache purges.
ground_truth_root_cause: S3 bucket policy blocking CloudFront purges

title: ingress-controller 413 Payload Too Large errors
description: Nginx client_max_body_size default 1MB exceeded by file uploads.
ground_truth_root_cause: Nginx client_max_body_size limit exceeded

title: analytics-service schema migration deadlock
description: Exclusive table lock acquired during high traffic window by unindexed DDL migration.
ground_truth_root_cause: exclusive DDL table lock during high traffic window
